variants.prompt: Standing at the edge of an icy forest glade, Ophelia shivers, her fur-trimmed coat thrown open to reveal a lacy bralette and high-waisted panties. Her skin glistens with frost in the crisp winter air as she looks back over her shoulder, her cold-pink lips curling into a smirking smile. The camera captures her from a low angle, emphasizing her athletic physique and the dramatic contrast of her heated gaze against the icy landscape. The shallow depth of field isolates Ophelia against the snowy backdrop, creating a sense of intimacy amidst the frozen wilderness.
